en.s: Battle of Wenden (also known as Battle of Kieś) was a battle fought during the Polish–Swedish War (1626–1629), between Sweden and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth on December 3, 1626 at Wenden (Cēsis, Kiesia) in present-day Latvia. en.s: The Battle of Arnee (or Battle of Arni) took place at Arni, India on 3 December 1751 during the Second Carnatic War. A British-led force under the command of Robert Clive defeated and routed a much larger Franco-Indian force under the command of Raza Sahib. The French troops were guarding a convoy of treasure. Clive took up a position in swampy ground, crossed by a causeway in which the convoy was forced to pass. The French were thrown into disorder and forced to retreat, but night saved them from total destruction. The treasure, however, was captured.

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1800 was the fourth quadrennial presidential election. It was held from Friday, October 31 to Wednesday, December 3, 1800. In what is sometimes referred to as the "Revolution of 1800," Vice President Thomas Jefferson defeated President John Adams. The election was a realigning election that ushered in a generation of Democratic-Republican Party rule and the eventual demise of the Federalist Party in the First Party System. It was a long, bitter re-match of the 1796 election between the pro-French and pro-decentralization Democratic-Republicans under Jefferson and Aaron Burr and the incumbent Adams and Charles Pinckney's pro-British and pro-centralization Federalists.

zh.s: 1800年美国总统选举是美国第四次每四年举行一次的总统选举，投票从1800年10月31日（星期五）持续到12月3日（星期三）。这场选举有时被称为“1800年革命”：副总统托马斯·杰斐逊击败了总统约翰·亚当斯。选举改变了美国政党格局，使民主共和党开始一代人的执政，并最终导致第一政党制度中的联邦党消亡。这是1796年选举的一场漫长而激烈的重赛，杰斐逊和亚伦·伯尔领导的亲法、主张分权的民主共和党人与在任总统亚当斯及查尔斯·平克尼领导的亲英、主张中央集权的联邦党人展开竞争。

In a close three-way race, Wood finished third behind Republican George Opdyke and Democratic nominee C. Godfrey Gunther. Opdyke was the first Republican elected mayor of New York City.

en.s: The Siege of Paysandú began 3 December 1864, during the Uruguayan War, when Brazilian forces (under Marquis of Tamandaré) and Colorado forces (under Venancio Flores) attempted to capture the city of Paysandú in Uruguay from its Uruguayan Army defenders. The siege ended 2 January 1865, when the Brazilian and Colorado forces conquered the town.

en.s: The 1869–70 New South Wales colonial election was held between 3 December 1869 and 10 January 1870. en.s: The Battle of Châteauneuf was a battle in the Franco-Prussian War that took place on 3 December 1870 at the Châteauneuf, Côte-d'Or, France. en.t: The first issue of Tamperean daily newspaper Aamulehti ("Morning Paper") is published
en.s: Aamulehti (lit. 'morning newspaper') is a Finnish-language daily newspaper published in Tampere, Finland. Established in 1881 by Finnish patriots in Tampere, the newspaper aimed to bolster the Finnish language and people's identity during Russia's reign over Finland. Throughout the Cold War, Aamulehti was accused by the Soviet Union of spreading US propaganda, leading to protests from the Soviet Embassy in Helsinki.

en.s: Himalia (), also known as Jupiter VI, is the largest irregular satellite of Jupiter. With a diameter of around 140 km (90 mi), it is the sixth largest Jovian satellite, after the four Galilean moons and Amalthea. It was discovered by Charles Dillon Perrine at the Lick Observatory on 3 December 1904 and is named after the nymph Himalia, who bore three sons of Zeus (the Greek equivalent of Jupiter).

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Toronto, Canada, on December 3, 1962. Incumbent mayor Nathan Phillips, then the longest serving mayor in Toronto history, lost to Controller Donald Summerville by a significant margin. Two major referendums were also held in Metro Toronto. The most controversial was over water fluoridation, which passed by a slim margin of 166,960 to 163,240. The areas outside Toronto also voted to remove some of the last of the Blue Laws by allowing movies to be shown on Sundays, something that was already allowed in the city itself.

en.s: The Battle of Hat Dich (3 December 1968 − 19 February 1969) was a series of military actions fought between Australian and New Zealand forces of the 1st Australian Task Force (1 ATF) and the North Vietnamese Army and Viet Cong during the Vietnam War. Under the codename Operation Goodwood, two battalions from 1 ATF deployed away from their base in Phuoc Tuy Province, operating against suspected communist bases in the Hat Dich area, in western Phuoc Tuy, south-eastern Bien Hoa and south-western Long Khan provinces as part of a large allied sweep known as Operation Toan Thang II.

zh.s: 黑迪奇战役发生于1968年12月3日至1969年2月19日，是越南战争期间的一系列军事行动，交战双方为澳大利亚第一特遣部队（1 ATF）中的澳大利亚和新西兰部队，以及北越军和越南南方民族解放阵线。在代号“古德伍德行动”的行动中，1 ATF的两个营离开福绥省基地，前往黑迪奇地区打击疑似共产主义据点。该地区涵盖福绥省西部、边和省东南部和隆庆省西南部，是盟军“全胜II行动”大型扫荡的一部分。

It was named after the Mongol conqueror Genghis Khan.

en.s: The Irish presidential election of 1976 was precipitated by the sudden resignation of President Cearbhall Ó Dálaigh in October 1976, following an attack on him by Paddy Donegan, the Minister for Defence in which the Minister called the President a "thundering disgrace" and implied he was disloyal to the state. Ó Dálaigh's resignation followed Dáil Éireann's decision to vote confidence in the minister in the ensuring row. Fianna Fáil leader Jack Lynch proposed as the party's presidential election candidate Patrick Hillery, retiring European Commissioner for Social Affairs and former Minister for External Affairs.

zh.s: 1976年10月，总统塞尔巴尔·奥达莱突然辞职，引发了这次爱尔兰总统选举。此前，国防部长帕迪·多内根抨击总统，称他“丢尽了脸”，并暗示他对国家不忠。围绕此事的争议中，爱尔兰众议院决定对部长投信任票；随后奥达莱辞职。爱尔兰共和党领袖杰克·林奇提名即将卸任的欧盟社会事务专员、前外交部长帕特里克·希勒里作为该党总统候选人。

en.t: Bob Marley survives an assassination attempt in Kingston
en.s: On December 3, 1976, gunmen attacked Bob Marley at his Kingston home, two days before the Smile Jamaica concert. Marley was wounded but survived. He appeared at the concert and later left Jamaica for London, where he recorded Exodus. The available primary source does not establish the original title’s exact number of attackers.

zh.t: 鲍勃·马利在金斯敦遭枪击后幸存
zh.s: 1976年12月3日，鲍勃·马利在牙买加金斯敦的家中遭枪手袭击，受伤后幸存。事发两天后，他仍登台参加“微笑牙买加”音乐会。此后他离开牙买加前往伦敦，并在那里录制了专辑《出埃及记》。现有一手资料没有证实枪手的确切人数。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Zaire on 3 December 1977. They were the first held after a new constitution was promulgated in 1974. At the time, the country was a one-party state with the Popular Movement of the Revolution as the only legal party. Its leader, incumbent president Mobutu Sese Seko, was the only candidate, with voters asked to vote "yes" or "no" to his candidacy.

zh.s: 1977年12月3日，扎伊尔举行总统选举。这是1974年新宪法颁布后的首次选举。当时扎伊尔是一党制国家，革命人民运动是唯一合法政党。该党领袖、时任总统蒙博托·塞塞·塞科是唯一候选人，选民要对他是否连任投“赞成”或“反对”票。

en.s: General elections were held in Venezuela on 3 December 1978. The presidential elections were won by Luis Herrera Campins of Copei, who received 46.6% of the vote. Although Copei received more votes, Democratic Action won the most seats in the Venezuelan Chamber of Deputies, whilst the two parties won 21 seats each in the Venezuelan Senate. Voter turnout was 87.6%.

en.s: The Who concert disaster occurred on 3 December 1979 when British rock band the Who performed at Riverfront Coliseum in Cincinnati, Ohio, United States, and resulted in the deaths of eleven people. The Who were in the midst of the United States portion of their 1979 world tour and had already played Passaic, New Jersey, New York City, Detroit, and Pittsburgh before arriving in Cincinnati. The concert was a sellout, with 18,348 tickets sold. The majority of these, 14,770, were unassigned general admission tickets that were first-come, first-served. A few hours before the show, a sizeable crowd had already gathered at the front of the arena.

en.s: The 1979 Sabana Seca ambush was an attack by Puerto Rican nationalist paramilitary groups on a United States Navy bus near a listening post in Sabana Seca, Puerto Rico on 3 December 1979. The bus was carrying 18 unarmed sailors, most of whom were communications technicians. Three groups claimed responsibility for the ambush: the Boricua Popular Army (EPB, also known as 'Los Macheteros'), the Armed Forces of Popular Resistance (FARP), and the Organization of Volunteers for the Puerto Rican Revolution (OVRP).

zh.s: 1979年12月3日，波多黎各民族主义准军事组织在波多黎各萨巴纳塞卡一处监听站附近袭击了一辆美国海军巴士。车上有18名未携带武器的水兵，其中大多数是通信技术人员。三个组织宣称对此次伏击负责：波多黎各人民军（EPB，又称“砍刀手”）、人民抵抗武装力量（FARP）和波多黎各革命志愿者组织（OVRP）。

en.s: On 3 December 1984, over 500,000 people in the vicinity of the Union Carbide India Limited pesticide plant in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India, were exposed to the highly toxic gas methyl isocyanate, in what is considered the world's worst industrial disaster. A government affidavit in 2006 stated that the leak caused approximately 558,125 injuries, including 38,478 temporary partial injuries and 3,900 severely and permanently disabling injuries. Estimates vary on the death toll, with the official number of immediate deaths being 2,259. Others estimate that 8,000 died within two weeks of the incident occurring, and another 8,000 or more died from gas-related diseases.

zh.s: 1984年12月3日，印度中央邦博帕尔联合碳化物印度有限公司农药厂附近超过50万人接触到剧毒气体异氰酸甲酯，这被认为是世界上最严重的工业灾难。政府在2006年的宣誓书中称，泄漏造成约558,125人受伤，其中38,478人受到暂时性部分伤害，3,900人严重受伤并留下永久残疾。死亡人数估计不一；官方公布的即时死亡人数为2,259人。另有估计称，事故发生后两周内有8,000人死亡，之后还有8,000人或更多死于与毒气有关的疾病。

en.s: This Tuesday in Texas was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), which took place on December 3, 1991, at the Freeman Coliseum in San Antonio, Texas. Five professional wrestling matches were scheduled on the card. The main event was a rematch for the WWF World Heavyweight Championship, which saw Hulk Hogan defeat the champion, The Undertaker, to regain the title. Hogan had lost the championship six days earlier at Survivor Series in a controversial finish. en.s: On 3 December 1995, Cameroon Airlines Flight 3701, a Boeing 737-200 operating a scheduled international passenger flight from Cadjehoun Airport, Benin, to Douala International Airport, Cameroon, crashed on its second approach to Douala after it lost control following a loss of power in its left engine. Of the 76 occupants, 68 passengers and 3 crew members were killed. Three passengers and two crew members survived injured.

zh.t: 喀麦隆航空3701号班机空难
zh.s: 1995年12月3日，喀麦隆航空3701号班机驾驶一架波音737-200客机，执行从贝宁科托努机场飞往喀麦隆杜阿拉国际机场的定期国际航班。飞机在杜阿拉第二次进近时左侧发动机失去动力，随后失控坠毁。机上76人中，68名乘客和3名机组人员遇难；3名乘客和2名机组人员受伤生还。

en.s: The Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Stockpiling, Production and Transfer of Anti-Personnel Mines and on their Destruction of 1997, known informally as the Ottawa Treaty, the Anti-Personnel Mine Ban Convention, or often simply the Mine Ban Treaty, aims at eliminating anti-personnel landmines (APLs) around the world. By August 2025, 162 states had ratified or acceded to the treaty.
en.n: In Ottawa, Ontario, Canada, representatives from 121 countries sign the Ottawa Treaty prohibiting manufacture and deployment of anti-personnel landmines. The United States, People's Republic of China, and Russia do not sign the treaty, however.

zh.s: 《禁止使用、储存、生产和转让杀伤人员地雷及销毁此种地雷的公约》于1997年通过，简称《渥太华公约》，也称《禁雷公约》。公约旨在消除全球杀伤人员地雷（APLs）。截至2025年8月，已有162个国家批准或加入该公约。

en.s: On 3 December 1998, a Yugoslav border patrol was attacked by a group of nine Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) attempting to illegally cross the border between Albania and Yugoslavia. Eight militants were killed in the ensuing exchange, while the border patrol suffered no casualties. This was the most serious armed incident in Kosovo since a truce between the KLA and the Yugoslav security forces that had taken effect that October.

zh.t: 1998年12月3日阿尔巴尼亚—南斯拉夫边境冲突
zh.s: 1998年12月3日，一支南斯拉夫边境巡逻队遭到9名企图非法越过阿尔巴尼亚与南斯拉夫边境的科索沃解放军（KLA）成员袭击。随后交火中，8名武装人员死亡，边防巡逻队无人伤亡。这是科索沃自当年10月科索沃解放军与南斯拉夫安全部队停火以来最严重的武装事件。

en.t: Worcester Cold Storage and Warehouse Co. fire
en.s: The Worcester Cold Storage and Warehouse Co. fire began on December 3, 1999, in an abandoned building at 266 Franklin Street, Worcester, Massachusetts. The fire was started accidentally some time between 4:30–5:45 pm by two homeless people (Levesque and Barnes) who were squatting in the building and had knocked over a candle. They left the scene without reporting the fire. The 6-story building, previously used as a meat cold storage facility, had no windows above the ground floor and no fire detection or suppression systems. The fire, which started on the second story, burned undetected for 30–90 minutes.

zh.t: 伍斯特冷藏仓库公司火灾
zh.s: 1999年12月3日，马萨诸塞州伍斯特市富兰克林街266号一栋废弃建筑发生火灾。起火是意外造成的：两名无家可归者勒维斯克和巴恩斯当时暂住在楼内，碰倒了一支蜡烛，火灾约在下午4时30分至5时45分之间发生。他们离开现场时没有报告火情。这栋六层建筑原用作肉类冷藏仓库，除底层外没有窗户，也没有火灾探测或灭火系统。火势从二楼燃起，持续了30至90分钟才被发现。

en.t: U.S.–Afghan force clashes with Taliban near Shah Wali Kot
en.s: On December 3, 2001, a force led by Hamid Karzai and accompanied by U.S. special operations troops advanced toward Shah Wali Kot in Afghanistan. Taliban fighters fired on its scouts near the town. By nightfall, Karzai’s reconnaissance group had secured high ground overlooking the town and a bridge over the Arghandab River, while Taliban forces still held the town itself.
en.n: December 3 fighting and seizure of overlooking high ground; the town was not yet captured that night.

zh.t: 美阿联军在沙阿瓦利科特附近与塔利班交火
zh.s: 2001年12月3日，哈米德·卡尔扎伊率领的部队在美军特种部队协同下，向阿富汗沙阿瓦利科特推进。塔利班武装人员在镇附近向前哨开火。当晚，卡尔扎伊的侦察部队控制了俯瞰该镇的高地，以及阿尔甘达布河上的一座桥；镇区仍由塔利班控制。
zh.n: 当天发生交火，联军控制了附近高地；当晚尚未攻占镇区。

en.t: 2002 National People's Congress election in Hong Kong
en.s: The election for the Hong Kong deputies to the 10th National People's Congress (NPC) was held on 3 December 2002. 36 Hong Kong deputies were elected by an electoral college.

en.s: The 2002 Intercontinental Cup was an association football match played on 3 December 2002, between Real Madrid of Spain, winners of the 2001–02 UEFA Champions League, and Olimpia of Paraguay, winners of the 2002 Copa Libertadores. The match was played for the first time in the tournament's history at the International Stadium Yokohama in Yokohama. This encounter marked a special occasion for Olimpia and Real Madrid, as both teams celebrated their centenary in 2002.

en.s: The 2006 Costa Rican local elections were held on December 3, 2006, same year that the previous general elections in February when Costa Rican elected president, vice-presidents, deputies of the Legislative Assembly and municipal councilors. These elections were held to elect cantonal mayors, members of the District Councils of each of the nation’s districts and Intendants of 8 especial autonomous districts and islands. Then ruling National Liberation Party won most of the seats and mayors with 59 as the seven provincial capitals. Main opposition force Citizens' Action Party was unable to repeit it success a few months before when almost tied to PLN, while Social Christian Unity Party become the second largest force at municipal level.

zh.s: 2006年12月3日，哥斯达黎加举行地方选举。同年2月，该国已举行大选，选出总统、副总统、立法议会议员和市政委员。这次选举选出各县市长、各区议会成员，以及8个特别自治区和岛屿的行政长官。执政的民族解放党赢得最多席位和市长职位，共赢得59个市长席位，其中包括7个省会城市的市长职位。主要反对党公民行动党未能重现几个月前的成绩；当时该党与民族解放党的得票几乎持平。基督教社会团结党成为地方层面的第二大党。

en.s: The Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela held presidential elections on 3 December 2006, to choose a president for the six-year term to begin on 10 January 2007. The contest was between incumbent President Hugo Chávez, and Zulia Governor Manuel Rosales of the opposition party UNT. After handily winning a recall referendum in 2004, President Chávez positioned himself for re-election in 2006 for a second full term. The opposition did not hold a primary, instead, the candidates reached a consensus into backing the governor of the largest state (Zulia), Manuel Rosales. Chávez benefited from a high popularity, and led most opinion polls throughout the campaign.

zh.s: 2006年12月3日，委内瑞拉玻利瓦尔共和国举行总统选举，选出一位任期六年、于2007年1月10日就职的总统。候选人包括时任总统乌戈·查韦斯，以及反对党新时间党（UNT）候选人、苏利亚州州长曼努埃尔·罗萨莱斯。查韦斯在2004年轻松赢得罢免公投后，于2006年竞选第二个完整任期。反对派没有举行初选，而是协商一致支持最大州苏利亚州的州长罗萨莱斯。查韦斯支持率较高，在竞选期间的大多数民调中领先。

en.t: 2006 Liberal Party of Canada leadership election
en.s: In 2006, the Liberal Party of Canada held a leadership election to choose a successor to outgoing leader Paul Martin. en.s: The Oldham West and Royton by-election was a UK parliamentary by-election held on 3 December 2015 in the constituency of Oldham West and Royton in Greater Manchester. This was the first by-election of the 56th UK Parliament. The by-election was caused by the death of the sitting Member of Parliament (MP) Michael Meacher on 21 October 2015; Meacher had been the Labour Party MP for the seat since its creation in 1997 and had represented its predecessor seat of Oldham West since 1970. A writ for the by-election was moved in Parliament on 2 November 2015, setting polling day as 3 December 2015.

zh.s: 英国议会奥尔德姆西和罗伊顿选区补选于2015年12月3日举行，选区位于大曼彻斯特。这是第56届英国议会的第一次补选。时任议员迈克尔·米查于2015年10月21日去世，因此举行补选；自该席位于1997年设立以来，他一直代表工党担任该选区议员，1970年起则代表其前身奥尔德姆西选区。议会于2015年11月2日提出补选令，确定投票日为同年12月3日。

en.t: Martial law is declared in South Korea
en.s: On 3 December 2024, at 22:27 Korea Standard Time (KST), Yoon Suk Yeol, the then-president of South Korea, attempted a self-coup by declaring martial law during a televised address. In the address, he accused the Democratic Party (DPK), which held a majority in the National Assembly, of engaging in "anti-state activities" and collaborating with "North Korean communists" to undermine the country, describing their dominance as a "legislative dictatorship".
